One Capital Management Trimmed Its Stake in Apple (AAPL) as Market Value Declined; Amdocs LTD (DOX) Share Value Rose While Beutel Goodman & Co LTD Has Boosted Its Position 
April 19, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
Beutel Goodman & Co Ltd increased its stake in Amdocs Ltd (DOX) by 4.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beutel Goodman & Co Ltd bought 105,089 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.29% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 2.63M shares of the edp services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $137.39M, up from 2.52M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beutel Goodman & Co Ltd who had been investing in Amdocs Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.57B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.86% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $66.73. About 194,222 shares traded. Amdocs Limited (NASDAQ:DOX) has risen 6.08% since April 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.47% the S&P500. 
One Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. One Capital Management Llc sold 3,706 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 34,608 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.86 million, down from 38,314 at the end of the previous reported quarter. One Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $879.48B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.54% or $4.51 during the last trading session, reaching $173.33. About 18.86M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 insider purchases, and 4 selling transactions for $19.89 million activity. 69,491 shares were sold by SCHILLER PHILIP W, worth $11.56 million.

Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 earnings per share, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 15.99 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth. 
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. Apple Inc. had 394 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley on Tuesday, February 21 with “Overweight”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, July 27 by Brean Capital. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Outperform” on Thursday, January 7. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Pacific Crest given on Wednesday, April 27. Guggenheim maintained it with “Buy” rating and $18000 target in Tuesday, July 18 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by Stifel Nicolaus on Wednesday, December 23. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) earned “Buy” rating by Credit Suisse on Tuesday, July 25. The firm has “Strong Buy” rating by S&P Research given on Thursday, September 17. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, August 2 by Citigroup. As per Friday, September 11, the company rating was maintained by Cowen & Co. 
One Capital Management Llc, which manages about $676.36M and $499.08 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr (IJT) by 2,564 shares to 60,815 shares, valued at $10.35M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (IJS) by 3,038 shares in the quarter, for a total of 68,221 shares, and has risen its stake in Ishares Tr (CMF).
